title: A saved color that is not for that part says so when the tool draws
goal: A tool can be holding a saved color that the picture does have, but that has since been reserved for outlines only. Drawing a box then quietly leaves its inside plain, with nothing on screen saying why, so the shape is not the color the swatch promised.
notes:
The third fall-through in PhotonzDocument.wearingArmedColorStyles: colorStyles(for: slot) no longer contains the id, and the fourth, where the tool draws no inside at all so a name must not switch one on. PhotonzDocument.armedColorStyleMissingHere in Sources/PhotonzCore/ToolColorStyleNotices.swift only covers the case where the document has never heard of the id; extend it with a second kind, or add one beside it. The pill and the wording already exist (ToolColorStyleNotice, CopyConfirmation.Subject.toolColorStyle).

Done: the third fall-through now speaks. The fourth (tool holds a name for a part it draws nothing in) stays silent on purpose and has a test on it: no UI path reaches it, since every way of clearing a fill also lets go of the name, and a box asked for without an inside is what was asked for. Left undone on purpose: the pill offers no way back (the fix is the Library tickboxes); the audit asks the user whether it should.
acceptance: Drawing with a tool holding a saved color the document no longer offers for that part says once, on screen, that the color did not come along
The message says which part was left plain, not just that something happened
Nothing changes when the saved color is still offered for that part
Tests in PhotonzCore cover it before the app code is written

log.note: Adversarial pass before building. Reachable in the real app: save a color from a fill, then in the Library untick Fills and backgrounds. Boxes already wearing it keep it, so arming the box tool from one leaves the tool holding a name the fill row no longer offers, and the next box comes out the flat color with no link and no word said. The fourth fall-through (tool holds a fill name while drawing no inside at all) is NOT reachable through any UI path: every way of clearing a fill also lets go of the name, so it gets silence plus a test rather than a sentence, because a box drawn without an inside is what was asked for.

Built. ToolColorStyleNotice.Kind gained notForThisPart; both it and notInThisDocument now name the part through a shared `part` phrase (The Rectangle's inside / outline, just The Arrow where the shape is all one colour). PhotonzDocument.armedColorStyleMissingHere renamed armedColorStyleLeftBehind and answers for both reasons, skipping a slot the tool paints nothing in. App side: EditorState.announceArmedColorStyleLeftBehind, once-per-picture key now carries the reason and the part as well as the name so one sentence cannot silence another. 8 new PhotonzCore tests; whole suite 3763 green.

Verified on the probe (Screen Recording granted, real capture): Scripts/playtest/saved-colour-not-for-that-part-walk.json. Save a fill colour as Brand, keep it for outlines only, draw a second box: the pill reads 'Brand is not for fills · The Rectangle’s inside is the plain color the tool remembers, not a saved color'. A third box after it faded says nothing. Needed one new playtest action, keepStylesForOutlinesOnly, because the Styles shelf tickboxes are in the dock and a walk cannot reach them with the pointer. Audit queue/audits/2026-09-06-saved-color-not-for-that-part.json with the capture beside it.
